# George Westinghouse — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is George Westinghouse known for?", "AC power, air brakes"),
    ("What field did George Westinghouse work in?", "electrical"),

    ("What is field?", "electrical"),

]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
